chunks: We enjoined upon man to be good to his parents; his mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his carrying and weaning is thirty months, until when he reaches maturity and reaches forty years, he says: 'My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve, and make good for me in my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.'
ai.seo_question: 《古兰经》中提到的四十岁时为父母感恩的祈祷是什么？
ai.summary: 在什叶派传统中，这节经文是确立三十个月妊娠期和断奶期的关键，常在教法和圣训中被引用，以界定成年前的完整发育阶段。它强调了从父母照料到个人责任的过渡，并指出对真主的感恩（shukr）与对父母的仁慈（ihsan）内在相连。四十岁时的祈祷为寻求真主协助以履行责任并为后代谋求义行的成熟信徒提供了典范。
